caption: Fig. 2.14 Boundary surface diagrams of the three 2p orbitals.
note: Three axis diagrams: 2p_x (upper left), 2p_y (upper right), 2p_z (lower centre). Labels are listed panel by panel - upper left, upper right, then lower centre - and within each panel in top-to-bottom order (orbital name, z, x, y); a strict whole-figure top-left-to-bottom-right sweep would interleave the two upper panels' axis letters and obscure which axis belongs to which orbital, which the flat list cannot otherwise show. The x, y and z in the orbital names are printed as SUBSCRIPTS (2p with a subscript x / y / z) and are written here with an underscore; the orbital names are printed in red, the axis letters in black. The arrowheads and lobes are artwork, not labels. Excluded from the grown crop (outside target_box_in_crop): the left-hand column body text, the tail of the previous figure's caption above the panel ("(b) Boundary surface diagram for 1s and 2s orbitals."), and the "these diagrams, the nucleus is at the origin. ..." paragraph below the caption.
